question.question_text: Which item was cleaned more often in the sink during the cooking activity: the knife or the wooden spoon?

answer_options.text: Both the knife and the wooden spoon were cleaned with the same frequency in the sink.
The sink was not used for cleaning any items during the cooking activity.
The wooden spoon was cleaned more often in the sink.
Neither the knife nor the wooden spoon was cleaned in the sink.
The knife was cleaned more often in the sink.
